scope: STATIC SOURCE ENDPOINTS ONLY. No generated frames, continuous motion, song synchronization, final edit, or full scene acceptance.

inspection.note: Scratch FFmpeg-only crops are review aids at native scale, not production inputs. New operator crops must preserve reviewed functional content and be bound to their own exact bytes.

pairs.observed: Full running figure remains oriented screen-right; different leg-support drawings and changed street/entry-step perspective are compatible with explicitly motivated lateral tracking toward the home. No phone or second body appears.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: Arm configuration is very similar in the two drawings despite changed leg phase. This is an uncertainty for a bounded running test, not proof of alternating gait. Require natural counter-motion, planted stance, real progress and no running in place or skating. Camera tracking is intentional, not a background-identity defect.

pairs.observed: Same closed residential door and porch; the far/right knocking arm lowers to his side. Body, coat and complete hands/shoes are readable and door stays closed.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: One knock must physically contact the door then release. Small stance settling is plausible; do not force frozen feet or invent door opening. No number-of-knocks or effort/timing acceptance comes from two drawings.

authority: Root owns canon/contract changes. Artist and reviewer are separate. No generator or GPU operation performed by reviewer.
